Test data
=========

``PBSO4.XRA``, ``INST_XRY.PRM`` and ``PbSO4-Wyckoff.cif`` are copied (with trailing whitespace removed)
from the ``tests/testinp`` directory of GSAS-II
(https://github.com/AdvancedPhotonSource/GSAS-II).
